observacao: Temas de busca no PubMed, tirados do projeto de doutorado. 'q' é a busca em sintaxe PubMed (máx. 20 operadores); 'dias' é a janela de indexação.

temas.label: Predição multimodal
temas.q: polygenic[tiab] AND (neuroimaging[tiab] OR MRI[tiab] OR miRNA[tiab] OR microRNA[tiab] OR multimodal[tiab] OR multiomic[tiab] OR "multi-omics"[tiab]) AND (psychiatric[tiab] OR "mental disorders"[tiab] OR psychopathology[tiab] OR depression[tiab]) AND (prediction[tiab] OR predictive[tiab])

temas.label: EV-miRNA
temas.q: ("extracellular vesicles"[tiab] OR exosomes[tiab] OR exosomal[tiab]) AND (miRNA[tiab] OR miRNAs[tiab] OR microRNA[tiab] OR microRNAs[tiab]) AND (psychiatric[tiab] OR "mental disorders"[tiab] OR depression[tiab] OR depressive[tiab] OR ADHD[tiab] OR anxiety[tiab] OR schizophrenia[tiab] OR "bipolar disorder"[tiab])

temas.label: PGS × neuroimagem
temas.q: ("polygenic score"[tiab] OR "polygenic scores"[tiab] OR "polygenic risk"[tiab]) AND ("brain structure"[tiab] OR subcortical[tiab] OR "cortical thickness"[tiab] OR "surface area"[tiab] OR hippocampal[tiab] OR thalamus[tiab] OR FreeSurfer[tiab]) AND (children[tiab] OR adolescents[tiab] OR youth[tiab] OR adolescence[tiab] OR childhood[tiab] OR neurodevelopment[tiab])

temas.label: Coorte BHRC
temas.q: ("Brazilian High Risk Cohort"[tiab] OR "Brazilian High-Risk Cohort"[tiab] OR BHRC[tiab] OR BHRCS[tiab])
